html: צאן (√ of foll.; DlPr; 87 f.; HWB cp. Assyrian ṣênu, adj., good, docile; Thes (cf. LagBN 136) cp. יָצָא [as πρόβατον from προβαίνω]; Assyrian ṣênu = BH צֹאן, and so NH id., MI31 צאן; Arabic ضَأْنٌ id.; TelAm ṣunu is Canaanitish according to Zim ZA vi (1891), 156; Aramaic עָנָא, ܥܳܢܳܐ, and perhaps Palm. ענא).
